tasks.title: Pitched roof steps end in a bottom slab, not a solid block
tasks.notes: From issue I-019 (snags S-068 David Kiddle w146985470, S-069 West west_w34391673; Southampton world). Cause, read from code only: pitched_roof_states (lib/builds/feature_build.py ~668) emits a full block for an even half-height and a top slab for an odd one, never a bottom slab; AND lib/site/site_kit.py rewrite_bottom_slabs (~line 123, called ~1037) turns every bottom slab in plan.cells into a full block on apply because block_fill cannot place bottom slabs, unless plan.keep_bottom_slabs is set (rules/craftsmanship.md line 175). Not verified: which half-heights count as a 'low step' (a top slab at y has the same surface as a full block at y, so the odd case needs a decision), and whether keep_bottom_slabs places roof slabs reliably. Read #149 first (it claimed slabs correctly). Deliver: (1) spike: how bottom slabs reach the world (keep_bottom_slabs for roofs, or exempt roof slabs from the rewrite), result written in this note; (2) pitched_roof_states emits a bottom slab at the chosen low-step case, same material family, slab-family fallback as #189; only that one branch changes; (3) tests in lib/builds/test_feature_build.py and lib/site/test_site_kit_slabs.py: stair run ending in a low step gives a bottom slab, ridge unchanged, valley, slab beside a stair, roof survives apply rewrite. Files: lib/builds/feature_build.py, lib/site/site_kit.py, and their tests. Out of scope: stairs between equal-height neighbours (same-Y rule of #169); that part of I-019 stays open. Checks: python3 scripts/run_tests.py --only test_feature_build and --only test_site_kit_slabs pass; roof lint passes; S-068/S-069: after dry run plus readback rebuild of w146985470 and west_w34391673, block_scan_region over the roof shows bottom slabs at the low steps and no full block where the plan has a slab. Independent review 2026-10-29: revised.
